properties.project_name: 25B -- surface parking lot (east of Mission Hall, toward 3rd St)
properties.digitized_from: Traced as the leftover open ground between DataSF's official street lines and neighbouring mapped shapes around the Mission Hall/Byers Hall area, as seen in satellite imagery, anchored on the real 4th St x 16th St and 3rd St x 16th St street-corner intersections (earlier attempts using building bounding boxes had repeatedly mis-centered on the wrong block). The resulting open area (about 7,505 sq m before shaping) spans the whole plan block from Mission Hall's own footprint east toward 3rd St; Pier & Point reads it as 25A and 25B combined, with Mission Hall itself being 25A and this record -- the part east of Mission Hall, idealized as a clean rectangle -- being 25B. Chosen and shaped by hand, not taken from a surveyed parcel.
properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-20: the owner corrected the prior resolution (which had 25A and 25B both lumped in as 'same hospital complex, absorbed into UCSF Medical Center'), and a same-day first-pass correction that mistakenly anchored on the 4th St x 16th St corner and pointed 25A/25B at Genentech Hall/Mission Hall (wrong block entirely, one row too far north/west; corrected without the owner's review, then reverted per their direct instruction not to commit un-reviewed conclusions). Re-anchored correctly at the owner's direction on both the 4th St x 16th St AND 3rd St x 16th St street corners: the real block spanning between them (fragment 14, 7,505 sqm) contains Mission Hall (already tracked, real building, = 25A) on its west portion and a real, still-undeveloped surface parking lot on its east portion. Per the owner's construction: cropped fragment 14 to a clean idealized rectangle bounded west by Mission Hall's own east edge, east/north/south by fragment 14's own extent -- 5,259 sqm, currently a painted-stall surface parking lot per satellite imagery, still planned/unbuilt per the OCII plan designation. CONFIRMED 2026-09-22: UCSF's own June 2025 CAC presentation (campus map updated December 2024) independently shows this same position -- directly south of Third Street Garage (23B), east of Mission Hall (25A) -- as 'Future Research (25B)', matching this record's position and planned/unbuilt status exactly. RE-ORIENTED 2026-09-22 per the owner's direction: the previous rectangle was axis-aligned (pure lon/lat), which cut diagonally across the real lot's own edges in satellite imagery (clipping real paved area at one corner, overshooting the sidewalk at another) -- the real street grid here runs at a slight angle, not true north/south. Rotated the same rectangle (unchanged size/extent) by 3.19 degrees around Mission Hall's own real NE corner, matching the exact angle of Mission Hall's own minimum-rotated-rectangle east edge (the wall this lot's west edge shares) -- now tracks the lot's real curb lines and the crosswalks at 3rd St/16th St closely on all four sides. 5,250 sqm (was 5,259 sqm; same size, just rotated). 2026-09-29 accuracy audit: the 'real, still-undeveloped painted-stall surface parking lot' wording is an imagery observation (striped lot with parked cars in USDA NAIP imagery, viewed 2026-09-29), not stated by the cited UCSF June 2025 CAC deck. The deck (page 3) supports the planned/undeveloped status: 'Undeveloped parcels remaining ... Block 25B - Research', and its map shows 25B east of Mission Hall (25A). `use: parking` records the current interim use (imagery) while status planned and the eventual use (Research) come from the deck; project_name's 'surface parking lot' has the same imagery basis. 2026-10-02: public-text pass. accuracy_caveat, digitized_from reworded for readers (meaning unchanged; no change to the shape, status, use or geometry_type); previous wording -- accuracy_caveat: 'APPROXIMATE -- idealized rectangle (owner-directed, not a hand trace of the lot's own painted edges) anchored on real street-corner intersections and the real, already-tracked Mission Hall footprint. The lot itself is real (visible painted parking stalls and parked cars in USDA NAIP imagery, viewed 2026-09-29, and in Esri satellite imagery in the earlier pass; imagery observations, not stated by the cited UCSF CAC deck); the exact boundary is idealized to a clean rectangle rather than traced to the pavement's own edges.'; digitized_from: 'Real-gap-fragment technique: bbox.difference(street buffer).difference(already-tracked polygons) around the Mission Hall/Byers Hall area, anchored on the real 4th St x 16th St and 3rd St x 16th St street-corner intersections per the owner's direct instruction (earlier attempts using building bounding boxes had repeatedly mis-centered on the wrong block). Fragment 14 (7,505 sqm raw) spans the whole plan block from Mission Hall's own footprint east toward 3rd St; the owner identified it as 25A+25B combined, with Mission Hall itself being 25A and this record -- the part east of Mission Hall, idealized as a clean rectangle -- being 25B.'.
properties.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE -- idealized rectangle (drawn by Pier & Point as a clean rectangle, not a hand trace of the lot's own painted edges) anchored on real street-corner intersections and the real, already-tracked Mission Hall footprint. The lot itself is real (visible painted parking stalls and parked cars in USDA NAIP imagery, viewed 2026-09-29, and in Esri satellite imagery viewed earlier; imagery observations, not stated by the cited UCSF CAC deck); the exact boundary is idealized to a clean rectangle rather than traced to the pavement's own edges.
properties.notes: OCII plan block 25B, shown by UCSF's own Dec 2024-updated campus map (June 2025 CAC deck) as 'Future Research (25B)' and listed under 'Undeveloped parcels remaining'. Immediately east of Mission Hall (25A), between it and 3rd St, north of 16th St; the position matches the deck's map. The block is a surface parking lot in USDA NAIP imagery (viewed 2026-09-29), an imagery observation the deck does not state. Currently undeveloped/planned per the plan designation.
